rule.statement: Evidence does not become legal evidence by mere fact that it passes into the record of the proceedings unnoticed by the judge or without objection being taken from the opposite side.
rule.supporting_quote: For the above reasons I am of the view that the 3rd Defendant has not asserted her position taken in the said answer dated 19/01/2004, by evidence before Court, to establish that she is governed by the law of Thesawalamai.
